statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Unknown"'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // ""'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); rate_limit=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); out="$model"; [ -n "$dir" ] && out="$out | $(basename "$dir")"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out ($branch)"; [ -n "$remaining" ] && out="$out | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$remaining")%"; [ -n "$rate_limit" ] && out="$out | limit: $(printf '%.0f' "$rate_limit")%"; echo "$out"
